subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Girish said, “We have not gone to Mexico”.

options.text: Girish said that they had not went to Mexico.
Girish said that they has not gone to Mexico.
Girish said that we had not gone to Mexico.
Girish said that they had not gone to Mexico.

solution:
The correct answer is "Girish said that they had not gone to Mexico."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in the Present Perfect Tense.
 
• Indirect speech requires a change in verb tense and pronouns.
 
• The rule for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:
 
 
• Present Perfect Tense Changes to Past Perfect Tense.
 
• Remove the inverted commas from the direct speech and replace them with an appropriate conjunction.
 
• The first person of the reported speech changes according to the subject of the reporting speech.
 
 
• ​Example: *She said, " Reena has come to see me."* (Direct Speech)
 
 
 
 

 * **She asked that Reena had come to see her. *(Indirect Speech)

 
• **"We"** becomes **"they" **in the reported speech.
 
• **"Have not gone"** becomes **"had not gone"** to reflect the past tense.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Girish said that they had not gone to Mexico.*
